service.status: Inspect the connected service instance and protocol version.
doctor: Inspect service readiness without opening new device connections.
devices.list: Refresh devices; disconnected mirror sessions may be cleaned up.
devices.capabilities: Refresh and inspect capabilities of one explicit device.
sessions.start: Start or reuse a device session and acquire a persistent client lease.
sessions.list: List sessions and their actual presentation states.
sessions.wait: Wait for a session state within the request deadline.
sessions.leases: List leases owned by the current client.
sessions.release: Release one lease owned by the current client.
sessions.stop: Release this client lease; close the backend only after its last owner leaves.
screen.capture: Capture a presented PNG frame with its geometry and freshness metadata.
input.tap: Tap at screenshot pixels using a current exported frame reference.
input.swipe: Swipe between screenshot pixels and always release the touch.
input.scroll: Scroll by normalized deltas at screenshot pixels.
input.text: Type text without clearing the focused field.
input.key: Press and release a supported named key.
overview.get: Read device overview from a selected Harmony device.
apps.list: List installed Harmony bundles; optionally omit system bundles.
apps.info: Read one Harmony application from device metadata without online enrichment.
apps.top: Read the foreground non-system Harmony application.
processes.list: Read the Harmony process snapshot with bounded device transport.
apps.start: Start an explicit Harmony bundle and ability.
apps.stop: Force stop an explicit Harmony application.
apps.install: Install or replace a Harmony application from an absolute local HAP file (maximum 512 MiB).
apps.uninstall: Uninstall an explicit Harmony bundle, removing its data. Never retried automatically.
apps.clear-data: Delete the selected Harmony application data. Never retried automatically.
apps.clear-cache: Delete the selected Harmony application cache. Never retried automatically.
shell.run: Execute one explicit Harmony shell script with deadline, bounded output and exit status. May change device state; never retried automatically.
ports.list: List only the selected Harmony device mappings in the chosen direction.
ports.add: Create one explicit Harmony port mapping.
ports.remove: Remove only the explicitly named Harmony mapping; never remove all mappings.
logs.capture: Capture a finite Harmony log artifact without clearing device logs
layout.dump: Export the Harmony UI hierarchy as bounded XML
